headline: Grokipedia gets a 'newly refreshed' design in v0.3 update, including a new logo
summary: Elon Musk's AI-powered encyclopedia, Grokipedia, receives a v0.3 design update with a new logo and refreshed homepage, signaling renewed activity after months of no edits.
details: Grokipedia, SpaceXAI's AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia, has received a v0.3 update with significant visual changes. This includes a new logo and refreshes to its homepage and live edits page, following months of inactivity.

The updated homepage now features a list of featured articles, most-read articles, and a tracker for "latest edits." This is a notable expansion from its previous minimalist design, which primarily consisted of just a logo and a search bar.

The new design incorporates a "book" metaphor for displaying featured and most-read articles, with horizontally-scrolling shelves of "book" spines. The live edits page has also been improved to make recent changes more visible.

Article pages have received minor design tweaks, such as a nicer format for key fact tables at the top and smaller spacing between lines of text. However, the core appearance of the articles remains largely similar.

Grokipedia initially launched in v0.1 in late October 2025, incorporating AI-cloned pages from Wikipedia, followed by a v0.2 update a month later. Earlier this year, updates appeared to cease entirely, with reports in August noting no changes for over three months.

headline: Apple TV and other services are down for some users, impacting subscriptions
summary: Apple is reporting issues with Apple TV and subscription purchases, with some users experiencing problems across other services as well.
details: Apple is currently reporting widespread issues affecting its Apple TV service and subscription purchases. Users are also encountering problems across various other Apple services.
The outage prevents some users from accessing content on Apple TV and completing transactions for subscriptions. The company has acknowledged the disruptions and is working to resolve them.
